newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa wins SAS Frankfurt cargo handling.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa wins SAS Frankfurt cargo handling.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG will take over freight handling of SAS Cargo at Frankfurt Airport from May, an SAS official said.
Horst Cerveny, SAS cargo sales manager Germany, told Reuters that handling is currently done by the airport authority, Flughafen Frankfurt/Main AG (FAG).
The transfer should be made in May, he added.
SAS generates an annual Germany export cargo volume of 6,000 tonnes and import volume of 2,000, Cerveny told Reuters in a interview last August.
The joint handling in Frankfurt is the first stage of a plan for global joint handling by 2000 which will allow both airlines to cut costs, a Lufthansa Cargo statement said.
